node_definition.done_when: The plan's §3 measure holds as written there, in tests/test_metadata_index_survives_restart.py, and its named negative control (the persisted index ignored) is executed and reddens the zero-parse assertion. The index module is reckon/metadata_index.py, so the later agent-reader section can import the same module and file. The gate is that new test plus tests/test_discovery_cache.py, tests/test_discovery_reads_each_file_once.py, tests/test_server_listens_before_it_watches.py, tests/test_serve_figure_rows.py and tests/test_serve_finished_runs.py, run at base and at head; the whole-suite comparison runs as a separate node at merge. Each arm is recorded as JSON carrying completed true and a literal command with absolute paths and no angle-bracket placeholder; each log names its revision on the first line and ends with a bare line reading EXIT= followed by the exit code. Every pytest process uses a basetemp private to that process, never a fixed path shared with another run. The head arm adds no failure id; any added id means status blocked, naming each id. ruff check and ruff format --check over the changed paths report no finding the base did not. Scratch goes under /tmp in a directory named for this run and is deleted before status complete, printed and listed in artifacts. An evidence fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/the-page-paints-from-an-index/metadata-index.html records the change. The turn ends once the manifest reads complete or blocked.
node_definition.goal: Land §3 of the-page-paints-from-an-index as the plan section states it: a persisted per-project metadata index that a restart reads by stat identity instead of re-parsing, and an index endpoint (the path /_index/ followed by the project name) that serves only its rows.
